concerns.text: FR-003 (Spec) mandates CUSUM implementation. Task T021 (and re-implementation T070) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No task exists to implement `code/scripts/baseline_cusum.py` or generate `data/results/cusum_predictions.csv`, leaving a core functional requirement unaddressed.

FR-007 and SC-004 (Spec) mandate a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds. Task T026b is marked [ ] (incomplete). No task exists to implement `code/scripts/sensitivity_analysis.py` or generate `data/results/sensitivity_analysis.json`, failing to deliver a required success criterion.

US-3 (Spec) requires visual evidence (correlation matrices, method comparisons). Tasks T028 (`render_fig1.py`) and T029 (`render_fig2.py`) are marked [ ] (incomplete). No tasks exist to generate `paper/figures/fig1_timeseries.png` and `fig2_method_comparison.png`, preventing verification of the research outcome.

FR-008 (Spec) requires framing findings as associational in the final report. Task T030 (`paper/results.md`) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No task exists to generate the results document, meaning the mandatory framing constraint cannot be verified.

Plan.md defines a strict `code/` prefix structure. Task T032 (path verification) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No task exists to verify that the repository structure matches the plan, leaving a structural requirement unverified.

Plan.md requires pinned versions and style consistency. Task T061 (Code Style Enforcement) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No task exists to enforce type hints and docstrings across all scripts, violating the plan's code quality requirements.

Phase 8 tasks (T065-T070) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Task T071 (Verify File Existence) depends on these and is also incomplete. No task exists to verify the existence of critical re-implementation scripts, leaving the 'missing source code' remediation unverified.
